name: Layer Health
description: Layer Health is privately held and has no ticker. Review its funding rounds, its investors, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Layer Health is a privately held healthcare software company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price, and the company has not disclosed the valuations at which it has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $21 million Series A round, was announced on March 27, 2025.

Layer Health, which was spun out of the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, develops AI software that reads medical charts to complete tasks such as clinical registry reporting and quality measurement. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
figs: Health systems that have announced strategic investments since the Series A announcement
table_note: Layer Health has not disclosed a valuation for either round. Amounts are as announced by the company.
round_notes: Define Ventures led the Series A. Intermountain Health's venture arm made a strategic investment in June 2025, and HIT Consultant reported on November 19, 2026 that Banner Health had also invested; the amounts of both investments were not disclosed.

A round valuation reflects the terms of the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Define Ventures led the Series A, with participation from Flare Capital Partners, GV and MultiCare Capital Partners. GV, General Catalyst and Inception Health provided the seed funding. Intermountain Ventures and Banner Health have since made strategic investments.
spv_sentence: No special purpose vehicles naming Layer Health appear in SEC Form D filings.
sources: Sources: Layer Health's announcements of its Series A and its launch (November 2023); reports by Axios (November 2023), Healthcare Innovation (June 2025) and HIT Consultant (November 2026); and SEC Form D filings.
